patch_description: Increase multi-switch exploration gradually when the search has stalled, using both parent-specific stalls and time since the last global improvement. The increase is capped by instance size and remains modest; it is slightly stronger on smaller instances, where the search has relatively fewer possible link pairs. Because `since_best` resets after an improvement, the search naturally shifts back toward smaller perturbations when progress resumes. This adds diverse proposals without increasing the LP batch size.
